title: Debt Overlay — required shape of a broker research set (stage 1 input, gated by node N0)
description: THIS IS A REQUIREMENT, NOT A DESCRIPTION OF ANY BROKER'S OUTPUT FORMAT. Broker notes arrive as PDFs, spreadsheets and emails in as many layouts as there are houses; none of them will ever conform to this on its own. What this document states is the shape the model REQUIRES after extraction — the houses, the metrics, the three forecast years and the provenance that must survive the trip. An extractor or an adapter produces this; nothing downstream reads a raw note. Do not edit this contract to match whatever a particular house publishes.

x_contract_notes.why_three: USER-FLOW-20260726.md stage 1 accepts 3-10 supplied houses so the evidence pack normally supports comparison and fallback. Eligibility is cell-derived after extraction: one complete primary-eligible house is enough to continue while other supplied houses may remain supplemental or reference-only. A quarantined or partial house contributes only finite verified cells and never invalidates another house. Ten is the operating cap because extraction and review cost scale with every additional source.
x_contract_notes.authority: The broker set is authoritative for the forecast anchor and consensus lines ONLY. Never for anything historic. Historic figures come from the filings.
x_contract_notes.accepted_file_types: A broker note may be supplied as PDF, OOXML spreadsheet, CSV, text/HTML/JSON, PNG or JPEG. Native text/cells are preferred. An image-only PDF or standalone image is accepted only through the hash-bound verified-image lane: two independent cell-addressed transcriptions must agree exactly, or a reviewed resolution must identify every disagreement. A raw OCR guess never satisfies the contract. Legacy binary Office files and message containers remain rejected; unwrap or resave the attachment first.
x_contract_notes.estimate_date_gap: Every house carries published_date because a six-month-old estimate and last week's estimate are not equivalent evidence. The v2 case preserves the date, source filename and source id in broker_pack.house_metadata while keeping each numeric broker series unchanged. Evidence-run validation blocks if that metadata is dropped.

as_of.description: When this set was assembled. Unlike the debt export's as_of this is NOT gated against a period end — a broker set is forward-looking and its collection date is properly recent. It is required so that the stage-5 read can state how current the consensus is, and so that a pack reused on a rebuild months later is visibly stale.

source_label.description: Human description of the set, e.g. 'Seven-house pack, notes dated Jan-Mar 2026'. Maps to model-case-v2 broker_pack.source_label, which is required there.

reporting_currency.description: Currency of every currency-denominated estimate. Must equal the issuer's reporting currency — a house publishing in USD for a EUR reporter must be translated by the extractor, because the model has no per-house FX and would otherwise average across currencies.

units.description: Scale of every currency-denominated estimate. Must equal the case issuer's units. Ratio and percent metrics are unaffected — see metric.unit_kind.

forecast_periods.description: The three forecast period ends every estimate array is aligned to, in order. Exactly three: the model is always 3 historical + 3 forecast years, fixed by rule and never asked. Estimates are aligned by POSITION, so a house whose note only covers two years carries null in the third slot rather than a shifted array.

metrics.description: Catalogue of the metrics this pack carries, keyed by metric id. The key set is the vocabulary; a house's estimates may only use keys declared here. Required ids — read by scripts/lib/coverage.mjs: revenue, depreciation_and_amortisation, effective_tax_rate, capex, change_in_working_capital, dividends. Plus at least one of ebit / adjusted_ebitda. The rule selects exactly one headline anchor by period-specific broker breadth, uses D&A as the bridge driver and derives the other headline. EBIT and Adjusted EBITDA are never simultaneous independent inputs.

houses.description: One entry per supplied house. Minimum 3, maximum 10. Eligibility is derived separately: a supplied house may be primary-eligible, supplemental or reference-only. A house appearing twice under different spellings is a duplicate, not a contributor, and N0 detects it by normalised name.

provider_consensus.description: Optional. A vendor-published consensus line per metric id, carried alongside the named houses and never mixed with them. Maps to brokerMetric.provider_consensus.

basis.description: consensus: three or more houses under one definition, consumed as a pooled series. attributed: one or two houses; consumed as the named house's own series, rendered wearing the house's name so a single voice is never laundered into consensus clothing.

source_house_id.description: Required when basis is attributed: the house whose series the line consumes. That house must supply all three forecast periods - an attributed row has no pool to substitute from.

confirmed_by_user.description: Required true when basis is attributed: the inclusion is the user's call, recorded from the single consolidated Stage-2 question, never improvised by the run.

election_gauge.description: The on-the-record weighing of every cash-flow leaf concept any house printed: elected as consensus, included by name, candidate for the user's single question, or parked - with house counts and materiality against the headline anchor. Nothing silently dropped, nothing silently adopted.

label.description: Display label — 'Adj. EBITDA'. Required because model-case-v2 $defs/brokerMetric requires label and there is nowhere else to get one.

unit_kind.description: Which estimates are in the pack's currency and units, and which are not. effective_tax_rate is a ratio expressed as a decimal (0.21), not 21. Declared rather than inferred because a tax rate of 21 and a tax rate of 0.21 are both plausible-looking numbers.

definition_id.description: Stable identity for the exact broker definition. Distinct reported, adjusted, restated, lease, cash-flow and scope definitions use distinct ids.

consensus_family.description: Optional family used to compare distinct definitions without asserting they are identical.

sign_convention.description: Optional but strongly advised for capex, change_in_working_capital and dividends, where houses disagree on sign and a sign error is a silent 2x in the cash bridge.

model_disposition.description: Optional Stage-2 disposition for a preserved broker metric that is not an independent model input. Omit for a metric that remains eligible for Stage-3 mapping.

model_disposition_reason.description: Required in practice whenever model_disposition is supplied; explains why the metric is retained as evidence but not consumed as a model authority.

house_id.description: Normalised, stable key — 'jpmorgan', 'bnp_exane'. Unique within the pack. The display name is what the model prints; this is what it keys on, so that 'J.P. Morgan' and 'JPMorgan' cannot become two contributors.

house_name.description: As printed — 'J.P. Morgan'. Maps to the key of model-case-v2 brokerMetric.brokers.

published_date.description: Date of the note. Required here; see x_contract_notes.estimate_date_gap for why it cannot currently round-trip into a v2 case.

document.description: What the estimates were extracted from. This is the provenance basis for every broker figure in the model.

media_type.description: The accepted list, enumerated so that an unaccepted type fails at upload rather than at extraction. See x_contract_notes.accepted_file_types for what is rejected and why.

text_extractable.description: Whether the raw document itself has a usable native text/cell layer. False is allowed only with a verified image extraction method and hash-bound evidence.

extraction_method.description: How the normalized estimates were obtained. verified_image_transcription and mixed_verified require independently checked, cell-addressed image evidence.

extraction_evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the PASS broker-extraction bundle that proves the document, tables and image verification lane.

page_reference.description: Where in the document the estimates table sits. Becomes the G3 assertion basis.

estimates.description: Metric id to a three-element array aligned to forecast_periods. null means the house did not publish that year — it is NOT zero, and the anchor's contributor count treats a series of all nulls as no contribution. Every key must be declared in the pack's metrics catalogue.

digest.description: The standardised face of everything this house published: every mapped metric in dictionary order, the broker's verbatim caption, per-period values, per-value verification grade and source locations. Derived entirely from proven mapping receipts; carries no number the pack cannot trace.
